svg.text: Native HA — Inverter Overload Protection
Current group shutdown + ordered recovery replaces the old Python shed-to-75% policy
1 · ENABLE AND TRIGGER
Automatic overload protection must be enabled
Inverter load >85% triggers group shutdown
Independent of DTEK availability
Unknown load cannot qualify safe recovery
2 · SAVE THEN REQUEST OFF
Save original states across shared protection cycles
Request OFF: microwave/bathroom plug, water pump,
boiler, HP2 and HP3
First-floor HP relay and fridge are not in this list
3 · WAIT FOR RECOVERY
Load continuously <50% for five minutes
Restart resets the recovery waiting period
Battery/overload interlocks must permit ON
Disabling automatic control stops restoration
4 · RESTORE IN ORDER
Only saved originally-ON plugs are eligible
Microwave → pump → boiler → HP2 → HP3
One-minute steps, load <50% before each next ON
Low-SOC battery protection may block an ON
5 · LOAD RISES DURING RESTORE
At load ≥80%, interrupt the restoration cycle
Request group OFF; keep the original snapshot
Retry after three continuous minutes <50%
Do not claim successful physical recovery
6 · OWNERSHIP LIMITATION
Plugs already OFF before the cycle stay OFF
A later external OFF is not a saved-intent cancel
Failed/unavailable devices need trace/inspection
Command notifications are not physical ACKs
Owner: native HA package. There is no parallel Python overload switcher and no 75% shedding target.
